dedupe_keys.name: opendata2citygml workflow to build citygml building models for energy simulation from open data

description: OpenData2CityGML, produced by Egbert Casper, documents how to turn raw open building data into CityGML models fit for energy computations and simulations. It starts from free CityGML building models in level of detail 1 or 2, for example from the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, or Shape data from cadastral and surveying offices, combined with OpenStreetMap and other data. The workflow checks what the energy calculation needs, selects the spatial extent, adds attributes such as year of construction, building function and heating type, maps codes and undefined values, exports CityGML through 3DCityDB and runs the SimStadt urban energy simulation, optionally with Insel. Coverage: German municipalities with open CityGML. Access: free scripts and a wiki on GitLab. Licence: Apache-2.0. Caveats: last commit September 2019, built for Debian 9, Java 8 and PostgreSQL 9 with PostGIS 2, so it needs updating. Simulation uses are preparing district building stocks for heat demand and retrofit scenarios. Related records: 3DCityDB and the OGC CityGML standard.
inputs: Open CityGML LoD1 or LoD2 building models or Shape data from German cadastral offices
Year of construction, building function, heating type
name: OpenData2CityGML: workflow to build CityGML building models for energy simulation from open data
outputs: CityGML building models prepared for energy calculation
